target: A project-attachment-v1 exact-byte large-file channel with 4 MiB authenticated chunks, resumable encrypted cloud delivery, atomic verified reconstruction, and project/conversation association metadata.
primary_semantics: Large project deliverables remain ordinary readable source files while Memory Wuxian records immutable manifests and transfers deduplicated exact-byte chunks independently from project-evidence-v1.
invariants: archive-v1, environment-v1, and project-evidence-v1 formats, ledgers, cursors, acknowledgements, and failure behavior remain unchanged.
Source files are never rewritten, moved, renamed, deleted, normalized, or replaced by attachment objects.
Every chunk and complete logical file is identified by SHA-256 over exact bytes; a receiver materializes nothing until all chunks and the whole-file hash pass.
A missing, duplicate, reordered, corrupt, wrong-origin, wrong-target, or cross-stream chunk fails closed without a partial destination file.
Old peers may ignore project-attachment-v1 without blocking any older stream.
The dashboard distinguishes local manifest creation, encrypted publication, peer acknowledgement, and verified reconstruction.
allowed_changes: Add an independent project-attachment-v1 store, manifest, owner, exchange manager, schema, CLI adapters, cloud transport binding, status projection, and explicit native envelope kinds.
Support closed selections of PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, TIF, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP project deliverables.
Use 4 MiB chunks, a 256 MiB logical-file limit, a 1 GiB generation limit, bounded bundles, deduplication, retries, acknowledgements, and atomic reconstruction.
Add fixed candidate, negative, interruption, replay, corruption, old-peer, Windows Unicode path, real PPTX/PDF, and rollback cases.
prohibited_changes: Raise project-evidence-v1 limits or place large base64 payloads in its existing package format.
Transfer executables, scripts, archives, credentials, private keys, tokens, unknown formats, whole workspaces, caches, or automatically discovered files.
Treat local indexing, cloud-file visibility, encryption, or upload as peer acknowledgement or verified reconstruction.
Garbage-collect a chunk referenced by any local or peer manifest, or infer semantic duplicates from filenames.
before_after_checks: Hash every source fixture before build, interrupted export, import failure, reconstruction, retry, and rollback.
Reconstruct exact PPTX and PDF bytes from shuffled delivery attempts and compare complete SHA-256.
Inject missing, corrupt, duplicate, reordered, oversized, disallowed, symlink, wrong-target, wrong-origin, and wrong-stream cases.
Run project-evidence-v1 and all older cloud-stream regressions unchanged beside the new stream.
Verify dashboard and CLI report each lifecycle stage without overstating remote completion.
